title: The Name field stops at 31 characters
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • A 32-character text, {Text-A}.
    For example: {Text-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S3-12 Thirty Two Char (32 characters).
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Credit Term" window opens.
  • Step 2: the Name holds only the first 31 characters; the 32nd is not accepted, and no error shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S3-R9, 31 characters: “The Name field stops accepting characters after the 31st. A longer name reaching the server is refused with "Use 31 characters or fewer."”
  • S3-R2, Name: “Name (required), focused on open, accepting at most 31 characters, with the hint "Up to 31 characters. Prints on invoices and goes to QuickBooks."”
  • Key Decisions: “Net terms run from 1 to 365 days.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "3 New credit term and Inactive tab" ("New credit term: Net X days"), page "1 List and row menus" ("A 31-character term name"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p3-01-new-credit-term-net-x-days.png
  • ct-p1-12-a-31-character-term-name.png

The design's own words:

  • “Up to 31 characters. Prints on invoices and goes to QuickBooks.”
  • “Rendered from the local build with "Net 45 Fleet Accounts Payable X" (31 characters, the longest allowed). At 1440px it fits on one line; on a narrower screen the name wraps and is never cut off (S1-R15).”
